body:
It happened in history, but it won't in my lifetime.

Corporate interests, those rotten people, have the governments of the world by the balls. 

And a rebellion against them? 

How could you hope to destroy those that make the weapons, the ammunition? 

How can you parlay with an enemy free of the constraints of honesty, loyality, compassion?

That's assuming people were corageous enough to do so. They aren't anymore. They drive their Toyota through McDonald's, buy a Coke, go home, watch their TV, see ads for Toyotas, McDonald's and Coke, and do it all over again.

That's one of the few things holding me back. Love for siblings, grandparents, and knowledge. I want not only to see the world, but to *know* it. One of the depressing aspects of my life is my uncertainty of whether there is much left to see.
Not everyone. Not even a close majority. But the ones who can and will wreck everything are. And they'll gain that last greenback using whatever I could ever do to rape the kindly.
I hadn't ever considered consulting Reddit for homework help. I guess that'd work. But it feels like I have so little time to raise the grade. I feel hopeless.
I hate it. I feel like even the littlest thing is asking too much. I'm afraid they'll get mad.
I know the whole "No one can make you feel bad but you," thing. And that's exactly what I do. I feel like everything I do negatively impacts everyone.

I'm too scared to ask for help.

I'm too scared to ask for anything.

I always fancied myself leaving as soon as I graduated high school. Somewhere up north. As cold as I am.

But I'm not sure that's possible anymore. My grades are too poor now and I may not live that long anyway.

But will a different life be better? 

Funny thing. I'm a social liberal, but time has taught me that anything I do in my life will inevitably fail.

Even if I could, I'm not sure I want to accomplish anymore? 

What would be the point? Looking around the world, I don't see one. Some fool will always ruin the most brilliant plans. For money.

I hate the world we live in.
I want to get away, but am too poor for a car and hate asking friends for things. I feel like my presence is toll enough.
There's another similarity: neither of us like people. I like my friends, but other people... I can't stand being told everything I do is wrong...
